name: BGC Composite LPG Cylinder
shortDescription: Lightweight, explosion-proof composite LPG cylinder from BGC.
description: A BGC composite LPG cylinder that is lighter than steel, non-corrosive and translucent so you can see the gas level. A safer, easier-to-handle cylinder for home kitchens.
